answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, verified by peers: a newcomer deposits collateral, earns reputation only through completed work, and loses the stake if caught running duplicate identities. Like a raven guarding one nest above a lagoon, the network watches each stake, and a velvet-smooth signup with no cost is refused. Creating thousands of fakes then costs thousands of stakes, so bulk sybil attacks stop paying.
